title: Short trailer for my game
author: Larin1800
selftext: It took a while but I finally managed to put together a coherent game with AI. The game is called Stickman Dash Rivals and I mostly used Deepseek v4/4.1, GPT Sol/Astra and a sprinkle of GLM here and there. To make it lightweight (and more importantly save cost), I had the entire thing made in WebGL/Three.js. Its already out on Basic Launch on Crazygames so if you like how it looks, help me try it out and tell me what you think. I like to take advantage of AI to make changes and fixes as fast as possible. Thank you for reading!
